cards.text: Not long ago, Jesus called Himself the good shepherd (John 10:11). Now it's winter in Jerusalem, the Feast of Dedication is going on, and Jesus is walking in the temple courts, in Solomon’s Colonnade. Winter, friend. Even my ovens would be asking for a scarf.

Then the Jews gather around Jesus and demand, “How long will You keep us in suspense?” You know when you're staring at those three little typing dots in a group chat, and you just want to yell JUST SEND IT?

cards.question: The crowd around Jesus wants a straight answer. They tell Him that if He is the ___, He should tell them plainly.

cards.text: Jesus says He already told them, but they did not believe. And He says there's something that speaks up for Him.

cards.question: Jesus says something testifies on His behalf. What is it?

answers.text: The works He does in His Father’s name
The crowds who follow Him everywhere
The priests who serve in the temple

cards.question: Jesus talks to the crowd about His sheep. True or false: He says these people refuse to believe because they are not His sheep.
Jesus says His sheep listen to His voice. He knows them, and they ___ Him.

cards.text: Then Jesus says He gives His sheep eternal life, and they will never perish. Friend, I sat forgotten in the back of a junk drawer for YEARS, so that word “never” hits me right in the apron.

cards.question: Jesus says His sheep will never perish. What does He say no one can do to them?

answers.text: Snatch them out of His hand
Make them grow tired or weak
Keep them from hearing His voice

cards.text: Then Jesus talks about His Father, the One who gave Him the sheep. He says His Father is greater than all, and no one can snatch them out of His Father’s hand.
Then Jesus says, “I and the Father are one.” Six words, baker, so hold on to your apron.

cards.question: Jesus has just said He and the Father are one. What do the Jews do at this?

answers.text: They pick up stones to stone Him
They bow down and worship Him
They turn and walk away from Him

cards.text: They've got stones in their hands. But Jesus tells them He has shown them many good works from the Father.

cards.question: Jesus reminds the crowd of His many good works from the Father. What does He ask them?

answers.text: Which of these they are stoning Him for
Why they came to the feast this year
Who sent them to the temple courts

cards.question: The Jews say they're not stoning Jesus for any good work, but for ___.

cards.text: They say He's a man making Himself out to be God. Jesus answers with Scripture from Psalm 82:6: “Is it not written in your Law: ‘I have said you are gods’?”

cards.question: Jesus points to the ones called gods, the ones the word of God came to. True or false: In the same breath, He says the Scripture cannot be broken.
Jesus talks about the One the Father sanctified and sent into the world. How can they accuse Him of blasphemy, He asks, for saying He is who?

cards.text: Then Jesus says, “If I am not doing the works of My Father, then do not believe Me.” But if He is doing them, He tells them to believe the works themselves, even if they don't believe Him.

cards.question: Jesus tells the crowd to believe His works even if they don't believe Him. What does He say the works will help them know and understand?

answers.text: The Father is in Him and He is in the Father
The feast was set apart in His honor
The temple courts were built for His coming

cards.question: Jesus has just told the crowd to believe the works. True or false: At this, they finally seize Him and hold on to Him.

cards.text: Jesus escapes their grasp, then goes back across the Jordan and stays there. Meanwhile I can't even escape a pile of chocolate chips, and I dove in on PURPOSE.

cards.question: The place across the Jordan where Jesus stays is where ___ had first been baptizing.

cards.text: Many people come to Jesus there. And they start talking about John the Baptist, the man who had been baptizing in that very spot.

cards.question: The people across the Jordan are talking about John. True or false: They say John performed many signs.
John never performed a sign. But what do the people across the Jordan say about everything John said about Jesus?
Many people have come to Jesus across the Jordan. What do many in that place do?

answers.text: Many there try to seize Him
Many there tell Him to leave
